people.name: William John Donaghy
people.birthPlace: Agnew's Lane, Larne, at marriage (1871) and at Robert’s birth (1879); died Main Street, Larne
people.marriage: High confidence: married Mary Ann McConell, 29 Oct 1871, Larne (https://www.irishgenealogy.ie/view/?record_id=cima-2760065).
people.note: HIGH CONFIDENCE. Married Mary Ann McConell on 29 Oct 1871 in Larne (index lists William Donaghy and Mary Mcconell; https://www.irishgenealogy.ie/view/?record_id=cima-2760065). He lived on Agnew’s Lane, Larne; father Michael Donaghy, a carter. Their son Robert Donaghy was born on 19 Oct 1879 on Agnew’s Lane, father then recorded as a labourer, mother Mary Ann formerly McConell (https://www.irishgenealogy.ie/view/?record_id=cibi-8839727). Died 19 Mar 1903 on Main Street, Larne, aged 53; informant his wife Mary Ann (https://www.irishgenealogy.ie/view/?record_id=cide-4630955). Born about 1850. Also named as father on the probable 30 Sep 1906 Carnlough marriage of Robert Donaghy and Ellen Magill (occupation there possibly steward, uncertain). The identification of that 1906 Robert with Phyllis’s father is not yet family-confirmed.

people.name: William Cooke
people.birth: 1888 (probable civil birth, Roscommon district); ages in 1915/1926/1947 also fit 1888–89
people.birthPlace: Birth registered Roscommon district (probable, 1888); later of Castlerea (1915 marriage; died Church Road, 1947)
people.marriage: Confirmed: married Mary Bridget Connor, 17 Mar 1915, RC Chapel of Ballinacree, Oldcastle, Co. Meath (https://www.irishgenealogy.ie/view/?record_id=cima-1785815).
people.note: Family-confirmed from the 1926 Irish census (14 Nov 2026): aged 37 in 1926. CONFIRMED marriage: William Cooke married Mary Bridget Connor on 17 Mar 1915 at the RC Chapel of Ballinacree, Oldcastle district, Co. Meath (https://www.irishgenealogy.ie/view/?record_id=cima-1785815). He was 26, a bachelor and postman, living in Castlerea; father Edward Cooke, labourer. Witnesses Philip Faughnan and Julia Ward. CONFIRMED death: 26 Mar 1947 at Church Road, Castlerea, aged 58, married, ex-postman; informant son Eddie Cooke, present at death (https://www.irishgenealogy.ie/view/?record_id=cide-2744819). Born about 1888–89. PROBABLE civil birth: William Cooke, 1888, Roscommon district, father Edward Cooke (labourer), mother Ellen Kelly (https://www.irishgenealogy.ie/view/?record_id=cibi-11250530). This supports the probable 27 Feb 1886 marriage of Edward Cooke and Ellen Kelly at Bissara, Athleague district, Co. Roscommon.

people.name: John James Cooke
people.marriage: Married 14 Oct 1943 (14 Nov 2026; a relative typed 2043, meaning 1943). Place not known.
people.note: Family-confirmed; a relative typed his date of birth as 14 January 2018 or 2019, clearly meaning 1918 or 1919. INDEX MATCH, FITS FAMILY INFO: FreeBMD death, Dec quarter 1976, Kensington, vol 13 p1814, gives date of birth 14 Jan 1919. Confirmed again by the irishgenealogy.ie civil birth: John Cooke, 14 Jan 1919, registered in Castlerea, Co. Roscommon, mother's maiden surname O Connor (direct record: https://www.irishgenealogy.ie/view/?record_id=cibi-1655605). Age 7 on the 1926 Irish census (14 Nov 2026). Parents: William Cooke and Mary Cooke (née O'Connor), both 37 in 1926 (born around 1889). Siblings: Edward Peter (Eddie), William Joseph (Billy), George, Esther Margaret (Pearly), and two younger sisters born after 1926 (names not yet known). Died 28 October 1976. irishgenealogy.ie civil marriages 1940–1950 for Cooke and Donaghy (all spellings) were nil, so the 14 Oct 1943 marriage may have been in Northern Ireland (place still unknown). His 1976 probate record exists only on scanned pages, which have not been opened. Family-confirmed: John and Phyllis married on 14 Oct 1943 (a relative typed 2043, clearly meaning 1943, the same sort of typo as John's birth year). Place not known. The earlier irishgenealogy.ie 1940–50 nil result still stands; the place may have been Northern Ireland (GRONI, paid — quote the cost before searching).

people.name: Phyllis Cooke
people.marriage: Married 14 Oct 1943 (14 Nov 2026; a relative typed 2043, meaning 1943). Place not known.
people.note: Family-confirmed. Spelt Phillis on her birth certificate; she insisted her name was Phillimena. The GRO death index lists her as Phillis / Philomena Phyllis Cooke, born 1923. Born 7 July 1923, died 15 August 2014. Married name Cooke. Parents: Ellen and Robert Donaghy. INDEX MATCH, FITS FAMILY INFO (14 Nov 2026): death registered Q4 2014 in Hounslow, GRO entry 511294357 (registration in the following quarter is normal). Probate: Phillis Cooke died 15 Aug 2014, grant 3 Oct 2014, London registry, probate number 4419073 — this matches the family date exactly. irishgenealogy.ie showed no Phyllis/Phillis/Philomena Donaghy birth in 1923, which fits a Northern Ireland birth: after 1922 those records are held by GRONI, not irishgenealogy.ie. irishgenealogy.ie civil marriages 1940–1950 for Cooke and Donaghy (all spellings) were nil, so the 14 Oct 1943 marriage may have been in Northern Ireland (place still unknown). Parents Robert and Ellen Donaghy are a probable match for the 30 Sep 1906 Carnlough marriage of Robert Donaghy and Ellen Magill (https://www.irishgenealogy.ie/view/?record_id=cima-1881497); not yet confirmed by family. Five Larne births with those parents are treated as her probable siblings. Her own 1923 birth was not found on irishgenealogy.ie, which fits a Northern Ireland birth held by GRONI. Family-confirmed: John and Phyllis married on 14 Oct 1943 (a relative typed 2043, clearly meaning 1943, the same sort of typo as John's birth year). Place not known. The earlier irishgenealogy.ie 1940–50 nil result still stands; the place may have been Northern Ireland (GRONI, paid — quote the cost before searching).
